message:
I’ve been thinking about my friend who tends to panic at the slightest hint of trouble. It reminds me of how helpful it can be to have a plan in place before an emergency strikes. I found this great resource that offers simple steps for creating a family emergency plan. It’s all about knowing what to do and who to contact, so we can feel a little more calm and collected when life throws us a curveball. 

Isn’t it nice to think that with a little preparation, we can help keep ourselves and our loved ones safe? I’d love to hear how you all approach planning for the unexpected.
